title: Vintage Gingerbread House Clipart PNG
author: KIDS ZONE
description:
Vintage Gingerbread House Clipart PNG – High-Resolution Digital Clipart Bundle
Step into a nostalgic, confectionery winter wonderland with this Vintage Gingerbread House Clipart collection. Illustrated in golden baked cookie browns, swirled royal icing whites, peppermint stripes, and candy sprinkles, this 20-piece series highlights charming fairytale gingerbread structures. Architecture features whimsical cupcake gingerbread cottages, hot cocoa mug houses topped with marshmallows, gingerbread village bridges, sweet train stations, treehouses perched in cookie trees, donut cottages, windmills with frosting sails, and candy train shops.
🎨 What’s Included:
* 20 Individual High-Quality PNG Images
* Transparent Backgrounds
* 300 DPI High Resolution for Crisp, Clear Printing
* Approximately 15″ x 18″ (4500 x 5400 px) Canvas Size
* Instant Digital Download
✨ Perfect For:
Christmas greeting cards, gingerbread decorating party invitations, holiday bakery packaging, festive home kitchen prints, cookie exchange tags, holiday mugs, and sublimation crafting.
⚠️ Please Note:
* This is a digital download; no physical product will be shipped.
* Colors may vary slightly depending on your monitor and printer settings.
* Preview images and mockups are for presentation purposes only.
